[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided 7 healthy breakfast ideas that can be prepared in under 30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 1: Avocado Toast (15 minutes) - Toast whole-grain bread, mash 1/2 avocado, spread on top, add a sliced egg, salt, and pepper to taste, optional red pepper flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 2: Greek Yogurt Parfait (10 minutes) - Layer Greek yogurt, fresh berries, granola, and chia seeds, optional honey or maple syrup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 3: Smoothie (5 minutes) - Blend favorite fruits (e.g., banana, berries, mango), Greek yogurt, and milk or protein powder, optional spinach or kale.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 4: Overnight Oats (prep time: 5 minutes, cook time: 10 minutes) - Mix rolled oats, milk, nuts, seeds, or fruit in a jar, refrigerate overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 5: Peanut Butter Banana Toast (10 minutes) - Toast whole-grain bread, spread with peanut butter, top with sliced banana, optional cinnamon or honey.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 6: Breakfast Burrito (15 minutes) - Scramble eggs, add black beans, cheese, and veggies, wrap in a whole-grain tortilla.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 7: Muesli with Milk (5 minutes) - Mix muesli with milk or yogurt, add fresh fruit or nuts.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the sound of the smoothie option.
